standard.summary: 概念编辑（concept-edit）训练所基于的模型家族：anima（默认）/ sdxl / sd15 / newbie / flux。决定加载哪套模型组件与训练路线。
standard.effect: 配置转换阶段从该值推断 model_type，训练运行时按对应家族加载底模、VAE、文本编码器并选择匹配的概念编辑分支实现。
standard.whenToUse: 根据你要编辑的目标模型选择：给 Anima 模型做概念擦除/差分选 anima，给 SDXL 生态用选 sdxl，以此类推。
standard.avoidWhen: 选的家族与实际提供的模型权重路径不匹配时会加载失败；训练出的概念编辑 LoRA 不能跨家族使用。

standard_en.summary: The model family that concept-edit training is built on: anima (default) / sdxl / sd15 / newbie / flux. It decides which model components load and which training route runs.
standard_en.effect: The config conversion stage infers model_type from this value, and at runtime the corresponding family's base model, VAE and text encoders load, along with the matching concept-edit branch implementation.
standard_en.whenToUse: Choose according to the model you mean to edit: anima for concept erasure or differencing on an Anima model, sdxl for the SDXL ecosystem, and so on.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Loading fails when the chosen family does not match the model weights you supplied, and a concept-edit LoRA cannot be used across families.

advanced.principle: 概念编辑（iLECO/ADDifT）的核心算法与模型族解耦，但前向、噪声调度、条件编码都依赖具体家族；该键是路由开关，让统一的 concept-edit 训练类型分发到家族特化实现。
advanced.intervention: config_adapter_conversion_core.py：training_type=concept-edit 时读取本键推断 model_type；trainer_side_train_runtime.py：运行时 base_model = config.concept_edit_base_model（默认 anima）选择训练分支。
advanced.expectedImpact: 决定显存、速度与可用的辅助功能（如 Anima 路线支持的 timestep 课程）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 各家族的成熟度不同：anima 路线功能最全，其余家族按各自 mixin 的实现覆盖度提供。

advanced_en.principle: The core concept-edit (iLECO/ADDifT) algorithms are decoupled from model families, but the forward pass, noise schedule, and condition encoding all depend on the specific family; this key is the routing switch that dispatches the unified concept-edit training type to family-specialized implementations.
advanced_en.intervention: config_adapter_conversion_core.py: when training_type=concept-edit, this key is read to infer model_type; trainer_side_train_runtime.py: at runtime base_model = config.concept_edit_base_model (default anima) selects the training branch.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Determines VRAM, speed, and which auxiliary features are available (e.g. the timestep curriculum supported by the Anima route).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Family maturity differs: the anima route is the most feature-complete; the other families provide whatever their own mixins implement.
